identity.description: Mailchimp, the marketing email and automation platform, with its Marketing API (audience, campaign and automation data) and Transactional email service (formerly Mandrill).
identity.identity_notes: The developer page describes the Marketing API and Transactional (formerly Mandrill) products. Official site is mailchimp.com.

auth.oauth_flows: Authorization-code style flow: register an app in the Mailchimp account, send users to the authorize endpoint on login.mailchimp.com, then exchange the code for a token. Exact grant details were not fetched.
auth.scopes_notes: No scope model was established from sources.

access.production_restrictions: No app review step was described on the OAuth app setup page. Transactional (Mandrill) sending requires a paid Standard or Premium Marketing plan plus a paid add-on, per a search-result snippet that I did not verify on the page itself. Free-plan API access is not confirmed by an official source.

resources: Campaigns (referenced in webhook and e-commerce docs)
api.rate_limits: 10 simultaneous connections per user (not per key or client); exceeding returns HTTP 429; 120-second timeout on API calls; no requests-per-second limit stated; batch webhook events capped at 500 pending per user
api.limitations: Could not fetch a full endpoint list, so resource breadth is unknown. No sandbox or test environment was found. Webhook retries occur over 75 minutes, and webhooks may be dropped or disabled if unresponsive. Browser CORS calls to the Marketing API are not supported.
